title: Clear the weeds
intro: Well, look at you! Tobias said you'd come.
This place is more weed than farm. Pull a few of those weeds and let's see some soil.
outro: There's the old dirt! Tobias always said it was the best in the valley.
Here, a little something to buy seeds with.

title: Your first harvest
intro: Pick a seed from the tray and tap the soil. Radishes are ready before you can say 'pie'.
Bring in five crops and I'll show you how to sell them.
outro: Look at that haul! They go in your barn until you sell them.

title: Fill the shipping crate
intro: See the crate in your barn? Anything you put in there, I'll buy. Not top price, mind, but it's instant.
outro: Pleasure doing business! Now, folks in town have been asking for fresh food.
I'll pin their orders on your request board. Orders pay much better than the crate.

title: Goldie's carrot order
intro: I've pinned an order of my own on the board. Four carrots for my famous carrot cake.
Bring them and I'll pay you properly.
outro: Perfect carrots! Oh, and Bruno the carpenter wants a word about that sorry gate of yours.
I think he left you a note.

title: Rebuild the gate
intro: So you're Tobias's kin. Good to meet you.
Bring me 4 wood, 3 stone and 60 coins, and I'll have that gate rebuilt overnight. Branches give wood; rocks give stone.
outro: That's everything. Leave it with me. Check your mailbox in the morning.

title: The grumpy miller
intro: Don't need help. Don't need a farmer. Don't need anything.
Fine. If you're so keen, bring me 10 wheat. Then we'll talk.
outro: Hm. Good wheat. Tobias's soil, no doubt.
The mill's wheel is jammed solid and the path is choked with old stumps. Bruno can tell you about those.

title: Old stumps
intro: Rufus sent you? Ha! Those stumps by the mill path have been there since before I was born.
Buy a saw from Goldie's store in Town, then cut two stumps. We'll need the wood anyway.
outro: Nice work. That wood will go straight into the mill.

title: Restore the mill
intro: The mill needs three things: timber and stone for the frame, wheat to test the stones, and coins for a new wheel. Find the project in Town.
outro: Listen. Hear that? No, you don't. Not yet. Bruno's fitting the wheel tonight.

title: First flour
intro: Wheel's turning. Now let's see if you can use it.
Tap the mill behind your farm, put in wheat, and bring me 3 bags of flour.
outro: Fine flour. Finest in twenty years. Don't tell anyone I said so.
Tobias will want to hear about this.
